Environment.description: The environment a recipe ran in, named by an IRI.

iri.description: An IRI naming exactly that environment, enough for its runner, at the version the record gives, to recreate it, such as a `urn:` IRI (`urn:example:env:sha256:…`) or one in a scheme of the runner's own.

Environment.title: Environment

Generation.description: A run of an output's recipe: the commit it ran from, what it read, the environment it ran in and the runner that ran it.

commit.description: The full id of the git commit the recipe ran from: a commit of the repository the record is committed in, the submodule's own commit for a result that belongs to an analysis in a submodule (the driver's commit for what a driver's universes build). It pins every file of the code and every `astra.yaml` in that repository: an analysis in a submodule of it through the commit the submodule is pinned at, and an analysis from a commit through its declaration's `commit`.

environment.description: The environment the recipe ran in.

finished.description: When the recipe finished, in UTC to the millisecond, such as `2026-10-26T14:00:02.000Z`.

inputs.description: What the recipe read: one item for each entry the output's `inputs` lists in the `astra.yaml` files at the record's `commit`, and no other item, matched by `entry`; the order of the items carries no meaning. A later change to the list makes the result `stale`, not `missing`.

runner.description: The runner that ran the recipe.

started.description: When the recipe started, in UTC to the millisecond, such as `2026-10-26T14:00:00.000Z`.

Generation.title: Generation

RecordedInput.description: One of the output's inputs, as the recipe read it: the entry, and the content hash and size of what the recipe read through it.

content_hash.description: The SHA-256 digest of the content the recipe read through the entry, another output's result or the file an input names, never of something standing in for it.

entry.description: The entry exactly as the output's `inputs` lists it in the `astra.yaml` files at the record's `commit`, such as `input1`.

size.description: The size in bytes of the content the recipe read through the entry, never of something standing in for it.

RecordedInput.title: RecordedInput

Runner.description: The software that ran the recipe and wrote the record.
Runner.title: Runner

description: The provenance of one result, which the runner that made it writes as JSON: what the result is and the run of the recipe that made it. Read as RDF, its top-level node stands for the result.

address.description: The result's address, as the analysis it belongs to names it: the output's id after the ids of the driven declarations that lead to it, then, for a result built in a universe, `#` and that universe's own id, never an import's, such as `subanalysis1.output1#u1`.

content_hash.description: The SHA-256 digest of the result's file, never of something standing in for it.

generated_by.description: The run of the recipe that made the result.

size.description: The size of the result's file in bytes, never of something standing in for it.

spec_version.description: The version of the ASTRA specification the record follows, such as `0.1.0`.

title: provenance
